keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Stephen Welsh (Swansea City).
Ebou Adams (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Swansea City. Ben Cabango replaces Stephen Welsh because of an injury.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, Swansea City 0. Terry Devlin (Portsmouth) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Odin Bailey.
Substitution, Swansea City. Elijah Just replaces Melker Widell.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Marlon Pack replaces Iyad Mohamed.
Substitution, Swansea City. Zan Vipotnik replaces Adam Idah.
Delay in match because of an injury Marezi (Portsmouth).
Substitution, Portsmouth. Abu Kamara replaces Adrian Segecic.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Josh Murphy replaces Ebou Adams.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Thomas Waddingham replaces Marezi because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Swansea City. Ross Stewart replaces Jay Fulton.
Substitution, Swansea City. Joshua Key replaces Filip Lissah.
Substitution, Portsmouth. Zak Swanson replaces Tyrese Shade.
Regan Poole (Portsmouth) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Portsmouth 1, Swansea City 1. Zan Vipotnik (Swansea City) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom left corner.
Goal! Portsmouth 2, Swansea City 1. Terry Devlin (Portsmouth) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Delay in match because of an injury Madiodio Dia (Portsmouth).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Thomas Waddingham (Portsmouth) Goal at 90'+8'
